seed_data_creation: Before initial load: localStorage.treesh_whatsnew_off='true', treesh_profile='{"nickname":"Tester","birthday":"2000-01-01"}', treesh_onboarded='true'. Set via Playwright add_init_script so state.profile picks up the nickname.
context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) Audio autoplay requires a REAL user gesture — injecting a <button onclick=startGame(...)> and page.click(it) works; page.evaluate(startGame(...)) does NOT satisfy autoplay policy. (2) Attach wnAud().addEventListener('playing',...) BEFORE the click to capture both the blob: silent-WAV unlock event and the subsequent real-song playing event. (3) wcCrew(state.game) returns an ordered list: main artist(s) first (no _by), then featured artists (with _by set to {n,id,img}); wnAvSrc looks up the main artist's avatar in ARTIST_BY_ID while featured artists use their own ._by.img — so Keelan (not in catalog) correctly falls back to initials. (4) 'Got \'Em Like' pulls ZuuBandz/Black Barbie exclusively from section labels (artistIds=['7','5'] = perfektenz members, not those two) — the wcFeat scan over wcLines(s) is what adds them. (5) The group-chat crew-length>3 UI renders exactly crew.slice(0,3) avatars + 1 .wc-av.wc-more element — total DOM .wc-av count = 4 when crew.length=4. (6) totEnd() closes the current challenge and renders [data-testid=tot-champion] with [tot-play-champ]/[tot-again].
